cashBook.title: Cash book
cashBook.subtitle: One cash box, a day or a range. Every line comes from the books with its running balance.
cashBook.emptyTitle: No cash entries in these dates
cashBook.emptyBody: Pick other dates, or post a receipt or payment on the right.
cashBook.noCashBody: Admin adds the company's cash account on Bank → Set-up. Posting also needs the posting rules there.
cashBook.readOnly: Read-only view: entries are made by the cash holder or accounts.
cashBook.noRight: You can see the cash book but not post to it. Ask Admin for the cash book right.
cashBook.reverseEffect: Posts a reversal voucher with the same lines swapped, linked to the original. The original is never edited or deleted.
cashBook.reasonShort: Write a reason of at least 5 characters.

entry.title: New entry
entry.reason: Why it must be cash (Admin sees this)
entry.errAmount: Type an amount above zero, like 1500 or 1500.50.
entry.errCounter: Choose the party or the account.
entry.overLimitTitle: Over the daily cash limit to one person.
entry.overLimitBody: Cash paid over the limit to one person in a day can't be claimed as an expense. Pay by bank instead, or give the reason and pay in cash; Admin sees it.
entry.payAnyway: Pay in cash with this reason

limits.title: Cash limits
limits.receipt: Cash of ₹{{block}} or more from one person in a day is refused (Income-tax Act 2025, s.186). Ask for a bank transfer.
limits.payment: Cash over ₹{{warn}} to one person in a day loses the tax deduction. The ERP asks for a reason and flags it for Admin.
limits.source: Limits come from Settings, which the CA confirms.

journalDlg.title: Journal or contra entry
journalDlg.body: Each line takes a debit or a credit. Debits must equal credits; the server checks and refuses otherwise. A contra moves money between cash and bank.
journalDlg.errLine: Every line needs an account and a valid amount.
journalDlg.errLines: A voucher needs at least two lines.

rules.cash.receipt_blocked: Refused: this cash takes one person to the daily cash receipt limit (Income-tax Act 2025, s.186). Take it by bank transfer or UPI.
rules.cash.payment_over_limit: Over the daily cash limit to one person. Pay by bank, or give a reason Admin will see.
rules.cash.limits_not_set: The cash limits are not set. Admin sets them on Settings first.
rules.money.over_allocated: An allocation is more than the bill still owes, or more than the amount.
rules.money.amount: The amount must be above zero.
rules.money.account: Choose the right cash or bank account for this kind of entry.
rules.money.counter: Choose the party or the account.
rules.posting.rule_missing: A posting rule is missing. Admin sets it on Bank → Set-up.
rules.posting.no_party_group: No account group is marked for debtors or creditors. Admin adds it on Tally books → Chart of accounts.
rules.posting.unbalanced: Debits and credits are not equal.
rules.posting.use_document: This came from a sales document; cancel the document instead.
rules.posting.locked: Only a draft can be changed or posted.
rules.period.no_fy: No financial year is open for this date. Admin opens it on Numbering.
rules.period.closed: This month is closed. Ask Admin for a "Reopen a closed day or month" permission.
rules.entries.backdate: This date is older than allowed. Ask Admin for a "Back-date entries" permission.
rules.date.future: The date is in the future.
rules.bank.no_match: This voucher doesn't move the same amount through this bank account.
rules.statement.admin_only: This statement includes documents only Admin can see. Ask Admin to send it.
rules.gst.no_rate: No GST rate for this HSN on this date. Set it on Product master → HSN and GST rates.
rules.doc.qty: Every line needs a quantity above zero.
rules.doc.discount: A discount can't be more than the line value.
rules.help.describe: Say in a few words what happened.
